title: Melvin H NDE 3251
content: It was a very wet morning and we were going to change out electrical transformers at building #445 and replace them with new types of transformers. Our work leader instructed us to kill the voltage to the transformers we were going to work on. My tool buddy asked why we couldn't kill all the voltage in the transformer enclosure? Our work leader said, 'No, just work it more carefully.' Into the change out about fifteen minutes, my tool buddy dropped his wrench. I told him I would push it out to the other side with my hot stick and at that time I was hit by 7,200 volts going through my middle finger on my right hand and exiting through both feet into the concrete, burning my foot prints into the concrete. I was slammed into the side of the building so hard that the paint of the building was impacted into my work jacket. My tool buddy removed my body from out the work area and started giving me CPR, he was raising up and asked the rest of our crew for help. My work leader told him what's the use he's dead. While all of this was going on, I was looking down on him and my body. Then I started out on a journey. I went over the top of building #100 which is referred to as the Taj Mahal, and I was able to describe the very elaborate roof tiles on the roof. At this time, I went back through my life seeing people I loved very dearly but were already dead. I went back to a time that my grandfather was holding me and he died in 1943. At that time, I was brought back to life as I was fixing to enter into this very brilliant light area, like a fog, that I had been traveling to during my journey. Everybody started saying I was crazy when I would tell them of my experience. This is a very short version of my experience during this time. I would gladly fill anyone in on the rest of my story if they were interested. I was clinically dead for around five minutes.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as starting out on a journey and traveling toward a "very brilliant light area, like a fog."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Electrocution while changing electrical transformers ("hit by 7,200 volts").

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Travel over a building and observation of roof tiles; encountering deceased loved ones.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with travel/observation, then life review/encounters with deceased, then approaching a brilliant light/fog and returning before entering it.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported seeing "very elaborate roof tiles" on a specific building roof while out of body; stated the electrical shock burned his footprints into concrete.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “While all of this was going on, I was looking down on him and my body.”; “I was clinically dead for around five minutes.”; “...enter into this very brilliant light area, like a fog...”
